content:
In batteries#1792, Batteries.RBMap and Batteries.RBSet were deprecated / deleted. This caused the toolchain bump in #40358 to fail because those were referenced in overview.yaml.

I'm not sure if we should now reference Std.TreeMap and / or the new locations in BatteriesRecycling, but in the interest of moving that PR along, I've commented out those two entries in this commit so that the toolchain bump isn't blocked.
